I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, hereby declare under Sub - section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provision of that Act.

An Allotment of land depicted in the Advance Tracing No. Ya/TLL/2018/38 dated 25.05.2018, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called Palai in the Grama Niladhari Division of, Palai Vimankamam North, Div. No. J/236, of in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Valikamam North in Jaﬀ na District of Northern Provice and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Kalanthalaisiddy – Extent: 0.0282 Hectares North: Kalanthalaisiddy Claimed by Logambikai Kankeyan and Sinnaiah Sambasivamoorthy; East: Kalanthalaisiddy Claimed by Sinnaiah Sambasivamoorthy and Path ; South: Path and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Kalanthalaisiddy Claimed by Logambikai Kankeyan. Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
